comment: Nx references `yarn docs:nx-targets:check` may find dead without failing. Every entry names the Markdown file that makes the reference, the reference as the checker prints it (`nx run <project>:<target>`, `nx <target> <project>`, `nx run-many -t <target>`), and a written reason. An entry without a reason is rejected. An entry is stale — and fails — when the reference is no longer made or resolves again. This is for a merged ADR recording what a command used to be (ADR 0104); a live instruction naming a dead target is corrected, not exempted. Frozen Research Briefs under docs/research/ and CHANGELOG.md are skipped as a class and do not belong here.

exemptions.reason: Records the `webServer.command` the decision set at the time. The same paragraph says the target has since become the inferred `myorganizer:start` (ADR 0083), so the sentence is history, not an instruction.
